issues.description: The problem statement and Dockerfile expect a start.sh script to be present in the project root and copied into the image, but no start.sh file is present in the provided template or solution repositories. This prevents students from following the Docker build instructions (COPY start.sh ..., chmod) and from producing the Docker image as described.
issues.suggestedFix: Include a start.sh script in the project root (and commit it) with the expected start logic, or update the Dockerfile and problem text to not rely on a missing start.sh. Ensure the Dockerfile COPY and chmod commands reference an existing file (and document the required contents of start.sh in the exercise).
